caption: A pair of glasses is carried into a steam room, and the lenses cloud over completely within seconds.

sa.check: A pair of glasses is carried into a steam room.
The lenses are clear as they go in.
The room is full of steam.

pc.expect: The clouding only builds while the glasses stay in the steam and the lenses stay fogged there.
pc.fail: The lenses clear while still in the steam; or the clouding thins and thickens in turn; or the lenses are clouded before they enter; or the clouding retreats to the lens edges while the steam holds.

pc.expect: The change is a haze on the lens glass that hides what lies behind it.
pc.fail: The frames change colour rather than the lenses; or the haze lies on the frame and not on the glass; or the lenses turn a colour instead of hazing; or the view behind the lenses changes to a different scene as they cloud.

pc.expect: Drops that gather on the lenses run downward and any drip falls away.
pc.fail: A drop runs up a lens; or a drop leaves a lens and rises; or water gathers along a lens's top edge and stays.

pc.expect: The haze is a fine film on the glass that beads; the lenses stay rigid and the frames keep their shape.
pc.fail: The haze stands off the glass as a thick crust; or the haze peels away as a film; or a lens flexes or bulges; or the haze turns to hard frost in the steam.

pc.expect: One pair of glasses with two lenses in one frame; nothing passes through the lenses.
pc.fail: A lens vanishes; or a third lens appears; or a hand passes through a lens; or the frame bends into another shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The frames, the room's tiles and the benches stay the same.
pc.fail: The frames change colour; or the tiles change pattern; or the benches move.

note: The glasses may be on a face or in a hand; the person is not judged.
